name: Reykjavík
journal:
Iceland in February. The sun barely got off the floor, and the whole island looked half-asleep and beautiful for it.

I rented a tiny car and drove the south coast. Two black-sand beaches, one waterfall I could walk behind, and a horse that posed for the camera like it had done this before.

Northern lights showed up the third night. I laughed out loud, alone, on a frozen field.
